{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A silk blouse with a relaxed drape, straight cut, length hitting at the hip, midnight blue (#000080), and satin finish.
Wide-leg trousers with a high waist, tapered leg length to just above the ankle, charcoal gray (#36454F), and heavy wool blend fabric.
Pointed-toe pumps with a 3 cm heel, sleek silhouette, length standard shoe size, burgundy red (#800020), and smooth leather material.
This outfit works for an autumn birthday party because the midnight blue blouse adds a touch of evening elegance while remaining comfortable enough for socializing throughout the night. The wide-leg trousers in charcoal gray provide a modern, effortless silhouette that balances the sleekness of the top without looking too formal for a celebration with friends. The burgundy pumps tie the color palette together perfectly for artificial lighting and add a necessary height and polish to complete the neat casual look she requested."}
